slide_title: Using  FF NN  for Multiplication of ONE Vector by a Matrix
subtitle_or_header: Example: Multiply Vector of Current Word X by W_q (Query) {Remember: W_q is Squared Matrix}

labels: Input Word X (left panel header; 'Input Word' black, 'X' red)
Σ (summation symbol inside each of the 4 neurons, left panel)
Y^T (top-middle panel, red, T is superscript)
IF No Non-linearity (black callout, rendered on two lines: 'IF No' / 'Non-linearity')
Y^T (bottom-middle panel, red, T is superscript)
X (top-right panel, red, label under the x-circle row)
+ (plus sign between curly brace and bias column, both right panels)
X (bottom-right panel, red, label under the x-circle row)
IF No Bias (black callout between the two right panels)
} (large blue right-curly brace right of each matrix, both right panels)
equations: Y^T [y1 y2 y3 y4] = Sigmoid   (top-middle panel: red 'Y^T' + row of four yellow boxes y1..y4 + blue '= Sigmoid')
Y^T [y1 y2 y3 y4] = Linear   (bottom-middle panel: red 'Y^T' + row of four yellow boxes y1..y4 + blue '= Linear')
Y = W_q · X + b   [implied by the diagram (X vector × W_q matrix, then + bias column); not explicitly written as text on the slide]

layout.arrangement: Title centered at top with a yellow slide-number badge '10' at the top-right corner; a one-line subtitle spans the width beneath the title. Below, three vertical zones: LEFT panel (~5-28% width) is a white blue-bordered rounded box containing a 4-input to 4-neuron fully-connected network labeled 'Input Word X'; CENTER column (~30-53% width) holds two stacked gray rounded panels (top: 'Y^T [y1 y2 y3 y4] = Sigmoid', bottom: 'Y^T [y1 y2 y3 y4] = Linear') with a black 'IF No Non-linearity' callout straddling the gap between them and a thick red arrow running down through it; RIGHT zone (~54-94% width) holds two stacked panels, each showing a horizontal X vector of pink circles, a 4x4 W_q matrix (yellow cells on green), a blue curly brace, a '+' sign and a vertical bias column (b1..b4 in the top panel; 0,0,0,0 in the bottom panel), with a black 'IF No Bias' callout and red down-arrow between the two panels at the far right. A solid black bar runs across the very bottom edge of the frame.

layout.hierarchy: The red bold title dominates, followed by the blue bold-italic subtitle. Inside the panels, the largest items are the red 'Y^T' labels and red 'X' labels. The black callout boxes ('IF No Non-linearity', 'IF No Bias') are small but maximum-contrast focal points, reinforced by thick red arrows. Matrix cells, bias boxes and node labels are mid-size bold; the 16 weight labels in the left panel are the smallest text. A consistent color code (blue/magenta/orange/green) links the left-panel weight labels to the corresponding matrix rows.

visual_elements.description: Fully-connected feedforward network, 4 inputs to 4 outputs, inside the left panel. Inputs: four pink circles (fill #FF9CEE, border #CC00CC) labeled x1, x2, x3, x4 stacked vertically. Outputs: four circles (white fill, red #CC0000 border) each containing 'Σ', aligned with the inputs. All 16 input-to-neuron connections drawn as thin gray lines. A vertical column of 16 weight labels sits between inputs and neurons, color-coded by source input: W_11, W_21, W_31, W_41 (blue, from x1); W_12, W_22, W_32, W_42 (magenta, from x2); W_13, W_23, W_33, W_43 (orange, from x3); W_14, W_24, W_34, W_44 (green, from x4). Each Σ neuron has a small multicolored pie/wheel icon at its upper-left and a gray halftone (dotted) circle beneath it, and emits a short green arrow to a green bold label y1/y2/y3/y4.

Two identical output-vector rows (one per middle panel): red bold 'Y^T' (superscript T) followed by a horizontal group of four small pale-yellow boxes labeled y1, y2, y3, y4 (black bold text), the group wrapped in a pink/magenta rounded-rectangle outline; to the right, '= Sigmoid' (top panel) or '= Linear' (bottom panel) in blue bold italic.
visual_elements.position: center column, two stacked gray rounded panels (~30-53% width)

A second thick red arrow points down from the 'IF No Bias' callout to the top of the bottom-right panel's 0-column.

typography_notes: Entirely sans-serif (Arial/Tahoma-like). Title: bold, ~28pt, red, title case with emphasized 'FF NN' and 'ONE' (extra spacing around 'FF NN'). Subtitle: bold italic ~16pt blue, with a larger red 'X' and a green italic brace note; subscripts used (W_q). Panel headers and node labels are bold; all weight/matrix labels use subscripted indices (W_11 ... W_44) at ~9-11pt and are color-coded. '= Sigmoid' and '= Linear' are blue bold italic. Callout text is white bold on black. 'Y^T' uses a superscript T. No serif fonts, no all-caps blocks beyond natural capitalization.

Slide number: small oval at top-right (~92% x, ~12% y), fill #FFFF00, border #CC6600, text '10' bold 14pt in #990000. 4. Subtitle text box centered beneath the title, built from rich-text runs: 'Example: Multiply Vector of Current Word ' (blue #0000CC bold italic 16pt) + 'X' (red #CC0000 bold 20pt) + ' by ' (blue bold italic) + 'W' (blue bold italic) with subscript 'q' + ' (Query) ' (blue bold italic) + '{Remember: W' (green #009900 bold italic) with subscript 'q' + ' is Squared Matrix}' (green bold italic). 5.
